day_shape: 63 items: State Department announces fresh sanctions on Iran energy-smuggling network, CENTCOM says US blockade has redirected 129 vessels and disabled 6, IDF reports killing Hezbollah engineering chief Abed Harb, Iran's navy claims warning shots at US destroyers (CENTCOM denies), and reports of Israeli special forces operating from Azerbaijan during the war.

threads.label: US blockade and energy-smuggling sanctions
threads.summary: The State Department announced new sanctions targeting a network it said smuggled hundreds of millions of dollars of Iranian oil, while CENTCOM said USS Tripoli is supporting a blockade that has redirected 129 commercial vessels and disabled 6. Iran International reported Iraq's Umm Qasr port has emerged as a workaround hub more than 50 days into the blockade; IRIB also reported a US military claim of seizing a sanctioned tanker in the Indian Ocean.

threads.label: Gulf of Oman warning-shots dispute
threads.summary: Iran's navy said it fired warning Qadir missiles and Shahid Dana drones at US destroyers in the Gulf of Oman, with Iranian state media and Defa Press carrying the claim. CENTCOM publicly rejected the account as false, saying Iranian forces did not fire on US warships and that US vessels continue to operate freely.

threads.label: Hezbollah engineering chief killed; truce stalls
threads.summary: The IDF announced it killed Abed Harb, commander of Hezbollah's engineering unit, in a strike last week, and issued evacuation warnings to multiple southern Lebanese villages. Netanyahu told the Security Cabinet there is no ceasefire deal after Hezbollah opposed the proposal, with Ben-Gvir pressing for stronger action and Smotrich backing a truce.

threads.label: South Lebanon ground exchanges and IDF weekly recap
threads.summary: Givati Brigade troops exchanged fire with Hezbollah in Zawtar al-Sharqiyah, wounding two officers including one seriously, while Defa Press claimed Hezbollah missile strikes on Israeli forces at Zawtar and Yhmr al-Shaqif and the downing of a Hermes 450 drone over the Bekaa. The IDF's weekly operational recap reported 650+ Hezbollah targets struck and 125+ operatives killed in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Israeli forces in Azerbaijan during Iran war
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported that Israel deployed elite commandos and intelligence units to Azerbaijan and operated from a Somaliland base during the Iran war. IRIB carried the CNN-sourced account, saying four sources described Israeli units operating within 96 km of Tabriz.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging on Imam Khomeini anniversary
threads.summary: Khamenei's office issued a message on the anniversary of Khomeini's death framing the "uprising of God" as the foundation of his school, and announced amnesty or sentence remission for more than 2,000 convicts for Eid of Ghadir. Defa Press and IRIB amplified Pezeshkian's line "the cypress stands but the storm comes to an end" and a Defa Press item claimed 70% of Americans want an immediate end to the war.

threads.label: Lebanese political pushback on Hezbollah
threads.summary: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun told CNN that Lebanon's people "are not Naim Qassem's people," criticising Hezbollah and Iran. Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri said any ceasefire should be unconditional and backed Hezbollah's withdrawal south of the Litani simultaneous with Israeli withdrawal.

events.title_en: CNN: Israel conducted operations in recent war by deploying forces in Azerbaijan against Iran
events.summary_en: CNN: Israel conducted operations in recent war by deploying forces in Azerbaijan against Iran. Four informed sources told CNN that Israel deployed its military and intelligence special units in Azerbaijan during the war with Iran and used them for operations against Iran. These forces operated at several points along the border with Iran; points that were only 96 kilometres from Tabriz, which Israel attacked throughout the war. The deployment in Azerbaijan consisted of several dozen military personnel, including members of Israel's special operations forces, rescue units, helicopter rescue personnel and Mossad staff. Preparation of these operations took place weeks before the war began.

Results of a new poll show that around 70 per cent of Americans want their government to end the war with Iran as soon as possible by reaching a peace agreement. In response to the question, 68 per cent of participants supported an immediate end to this war. In contrast, 11 per cent opposed and 21 per cent said they had not decided in this regard. According to this poll, 60 per cent of respondents said they were opposed to the war.
